title: SwingVision Match Quality Import Freshness Gap
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swingvision:session
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by player
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects athletes, devices, or exports that have stopped sending swingvision match quality data within the expected freshness window.
value: Stale performance data hides missed sessions and broken syncs, so a freshness alert protects the trend lines you rely on.
implementation: Review this at least daily and tune the freshness threshold to the normal cadence of the underlying app or export job.
visualization: Table of player values by hours since the last swingvision match quality event.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when data for swingvision match quality has stopped arriving and probably needs a sync check.
